title: DNA Extraction from Rectal Mucosa Biopsies for Microbiome Analysis
author: Lee Murphy

steps.title: Label and weigh tube
steps.instruction: Label a 2 mL Eppendorf tube, weigh it, add the rectal mucosa biopsy, re‑weigh to record tissue weight (aim 5–60 mg).

steps.title: Add lysis reagents
steps.instruction: Add 828 µL Sodium Phosphate buffer, 122 µL MT buffer (MPBio), 50 µL Lysozyme (100 mg/mL) and 50 µL Mutanolysin (5 U/µL); vortex briefly and incubate at 37 °C for 1 h on a heat block.

steps.title: Bead beat sample
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a MP Biomedicals FastPrep‑24 and bead‑beat for 1 min at 5 m/s.

steps.title: Transfer to Matrix E tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire contents of the Eppendorf tube to a Matrix E tube (MPBio kit).

steps.title: High‑temp incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the Matrix E tube at 85 °C for 15 min on a heating block.

steps.title: Repeat bead‑beat & heat
steps.instruction: Repeat the bead‑beating (1 min, 5 m/s) and the 85 °C incubation (15 min) once more.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 5 min; transfer the supernatant to a fresh 2 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Add PPS solution
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL PPS solution (MPBio) to the tube and mix by inverting 12 times.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 5 min; transfer the supernatant to a 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Clear flow‑through
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 1 min and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Resuspend matrix
steps.instruction: Pipette up and down to gently resuspend the remaining matrix and transfer 600 µL to a spin‑filter column (MPBio).

steps.title: Discard excess supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove and discard 500 µL supernatant without disturbing the binding matrix at the tube bottom.

steps.title: Mix and settle
steps.instruction: Invert the 15 mL tube for 2 min, then let stand 5 min to collect the binding matrix at the bottom.

steps.title: Apply remaining matrix
steps.instruction: Repeat the resuspend‑transfer (step 10) and discard‑excess (step 11) cycles as needed until all binding‑matrix solution has been applied to the spin‑filter column.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the spin‑filter column at 14,000 rpm for 1 min to collect the eluate; remove the column and store the DNA tube for QC and downstream enrichment.

steps.title: Elute with DES buffer
steps.instruction: Apply 80 µL DES elution buffer to the matrix in the spin column, pipette gently up/down to resuspend (pre‑heat DES at 55 °C for 5 min if desired).

steps.title: Air‑dry column
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the spin column for 5 min, then transfer it to a fresh, labelled catch tube.

steps.title: Final dry spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 1 min, discard flow‑through, then centrifuge again at 14,000 rpm for 2 min to dry the column.

steps.title: SEWSM wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL SEWSM wash buffer (MPBio) to the spin column, pipette gently until the matrix is fully resuspended (ensure the buffer contains 100 % ethanol per kit instructions).

steps.title: Label stool tube
steps.instruction: Label and weigh a 2 mL Matrix E tube, add approximately 0.2 g stool, and record the weight.

steps.title: Add stool lysis reagents
steps.instruction: Add 928 µL Sodium Phosphate buffer and 122 µL MT buffer (MPBio) to the stool sample in the Matrix E tube.

steps.title: Bead beat stool
steps.instruction: Bead‑beat the stool mixture in a FastPrep‑24 for 1 min at 5 m/s.

steps.title: Stool heat incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the stool tube at 85 °C for 15 min on a heating block.

steps.title: Repeat stool bead‑beat & heat
steps.instruction: Repeat the bead‑beating (1 min, 5 m/s) and 85 °C incubation (15 min) once more.

steps.title: Stool first centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 5 min; transfer supernatant to a fresh 2 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Add PPS to stool
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL PPS solution (MPBio) and mix by inverting 12 times.

steps.title: Stool second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 5 min; transfer supernatant to a 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Resuspend binding matrix
steps.instruction: Vortex the Binding Matrix (MPBio) to fully resuspend, then add 1 mL to the 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Mix and settle stool
steps.instruction: Invert the 15 mL tube for 2 min, then let stand 5 min to collect the binding matrix at the bottom.

steps.title: Discard stool supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove and discard 500 µL supernatant without disturbing the binding matrix.

steps.title: Transfer stool matrix
steps.instruction: Gently resuspend the remaining matrix by pipetting up/down and transfer 600 µL to a spin‑filter column.

steps.title: Clear stool flow‑through
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 1 min and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Apply remaining stool matrix
steps.instruction: Repeat the transfer (step 26) and clear flow‑through (step 27) cycles as needed until all binding‑matrix solution has been applied to the spin‑filter column.

steps.title: Stool SEWSM wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL SEWSM wash buffer (MPBio) to the spin column, pipette gently until the matrix is fully resuspended (buffer must contain 100 % ethanol).

steps.title: Stool final dry spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 1 min, discard flow‑through, then centrifuge again at 14,000 rpm for 2 min to dry the column.

steps.title: Stool air‑dry column
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the spin column for 5 min and transfer it to a fresh, labelled catch tube.

steps.title: Stool DES elution
steps.instruction: Apply 80 µL DES elution buffer to the matrix in the spin column, pipette gently up/down (pre‑heat DES at 55 °C for 5 min if desired).

steps.title: Collect stool eluate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 1 min to collect the eluate; remove the spin column and store the DNA tube for QC.
